title: Austin Housing Boost: $2.5M, 7 New Homes
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved a nearly $2.5 million increase to the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's operating budget for fiscal year 2004-2005.
*   The budget boost included substantial funding for the Anderson Hill Program and the Rental Housing Development Assistance Program.
*   Authorized a construction contract of over $448,000 to build seven new single-family homes in the Anderson Hill neighborhood.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING MINUTES
THURSDAY, June 9,2005
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened on
Thursday, June 9, 2005, in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 301 \V. 2* Street, Austin, Texas.
The following were the AHFC items considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's
Board of Directors.
President Wynn called the meeting to order at 3:38 p.m.
AHFC-1 
Approve the minutes of the May 12, 2005 Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance
Corporation.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation meeting of May 12,2005
were approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board Member Dunkerley'i
second on a 6-0 vote. Board Member Thomas was off the dais.
AHFC-2 
Approve a resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2004-2005 Austin Housing Finance
Corporation Operating Budget of Resolution No. 040913-1 to increase the Anderson Hill
Program line item by an amount equal to $2,089,646, and to increase the Rental Housing
Development Assistance Program by an amount equal to $403,051 for a total operating
budget increase equal to $2,492,697; and authorize an amendment to the one-year service
agreement with the City of Austin in an amount not to exceed $2,492,697 for a total
amount not to exceed $16,192,367 for the purpose of increasing available funding
available to the Austin Housing Finance Corporation to manage and operate various City
housing programs in Fiscal Year 2004-2005. (Funding in the amount of $1,847,442 from
the HOME Investment Partnership Program; $645,255 in CDBG from the NHCD Grant
Operating Budget for Fiscal Year 2004-2005.) (Related Items 13, AHFC-3)
Resolution No. 20050609-AHFC002 and the motion authorizing an amendment to a
service agreement was approved on Board Member Alvarez' motion, Vice President
Goodman's second on a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-3 
Approve the negotiation and execution of a construction contract with DITTMAR
HOMES, Austin, TX, in compliance with applicable federal requirements, including
Code of Federal Regulations Title 24 Section 85.40 performance goals, under the
Acquisition and Development Program in an amount no to exceed $448,203 to build
seven single family houses in the Anderson Hill neighborhood. (Funding is available
from the Grant Operating budget, from HOME Investment Partnership program for Fiscal
Year 2004-2005.) (Related Items 13, AHFC-2)
The motion authorizing the negotiation and execution of a construction contract was
approved on Board Member Thomas' motion, Board Member Slusher's second on a
7-0 vote.
The meeting was adjourned without objection at 3:47 p.m.
